mostWorthwhile.text: Looping the belt around both pulleys was the most worthwhile step: it gave the motor assembly a clear mechanical purpose.

leastWorthwhile.text: Mounting the projector felt less rewarding because the result only named the carrier, without describing the visible addition.

surprise.text: Nothing particularly surprised me; the goals made the assembly sequence predictable.

continue.text: I would probably not continue personally: the construction sequence was clear, but the terse results and mostly single available choices held my interest only briefly.
